"""Offline NetNomos finite-domain command line.

Reads one JSON batch ``{"jobs":[...]}`` from stdin until EOF and writes one
JSON result ``{"results":[...]}`` to stdout, exactly once.
"""
import ctypes
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
DEPS = Path(os.environ.get('NETNOMOS_DEPS', str(ROOT.parent / 'vendor')))
if not DEPS.is_dir():
    DEPS = Path('/workspace/vendor')
libz = DEPS / 'system-libs/libz.so.1'
if libz.is_file():
    ctypes.CDLL(str(libz), mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
sys.path.insert(0, str(DEPS))
from tqdm import tqdm
tqdm.monitor_interval = 0  # no optional monitor thread
from netnomos.finite import compile_batch


def main():
    raw = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    batch = json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8'))
    payload = json.dumps({'results': compile_batch(batch)}, separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf-8')
    stream = sys.stdout.buffer
    stream.write(payload)
    stream.write(b'\n')
    stream.flush()
    os._exit(0)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
